network_enforcement: The release checker itself is not network-namespace isolated. It requests no network operation and replays the validation recipe, whose four Lean invocations use bubblewrap --unshare-net. The outer-process boundary and shared warm pinned dependency cache make this explicitly nonrelease evidence.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: contains PASS S56-M-0450-RELEASE reconciliation and the exact blocked, unchanged terminal decision

scope_boundary: Fail-closed worker reconciliation plus the recorded network-denied narrow validation replay. It cannot accept its provisional dependency, construct weak Mordell-Weil or elliptic height inputs, close the exact root, supply H0/R0, complete provenance/TCB/SBOM closure, perform a cold offline build, provide independent attestations or a minimal verifier, assemble a deterministic release bundle, or establish AUDIT-Z or THEOREM-Z.
